verdict.rationale: Google documents an official Gemini app for Mac that works without a browser, and a system-wide Option + Space shortcut that brings up the chat window. On-screen awareness is documented only for Android ("Hey Google" to get help with what's on your screen), not for the desktop app. Missing for 10: documented screen access or screen-context sharing in the desktop app, evidence of desktop apps beyond Mac (e.g. Windows), and independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.
